text:
maya: Quick announcement — Rolling FastRoute endpoint (hosted.fastroute) and minimax-3-small model to GA for production apps starting 17:00 PT. :tada:

leo: Nice. What changes for clients? Any breaking config?

maya: No breaking changes. New endpoint name: /v1/fastroute/generate. Streaming + tool-calling supported. Default model mapping will still be hosted/minimax-3-small.

liz-devex: Docs are up: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/fastroute (internal). We'll publish public guide after 3pm.

hannah: Ops note: default rate limit increases for GA tiers. Hosted-free stays same. Dedicated customers unaffected.

maya: TL;DR: 
- GA at 17:00 PT
- New endpoint: /v1/fastroute/generate
- Model: minimax-3-small (GA)
- Streaming + tool-calling: enabled
- Rate limit tweak on paid tiers

leo: Any rollout windows / canary?

maya: Rolling canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~90m. Auto rollback on 5xx spike >3%.

devops-bot: Deploy started: deploy-id=dr-1997, route=fastroute, canary=10%, user=deploy-service

leo: How to opt in manually?

maya: Use header X-Feature-Flag: fastroute-beta or call explicit endpoint. Example:

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/fastroute/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"minimax-3-small","input":"Summarize this...","stream":true}'
```

hannah: Monitoring: dashboards + alert runbooks updated. Tagging: service=fastroute, model=minimax-3-small

sam-exec: Super — big win for latency focused apps. Any known regressions in quality vs minimax-2?

maya: Eval summary: ~1.8% delta on longer-context hallucination metric vs minimax-2 but 30% lower median latency. Recommend fallback policy to minimax-2 for high-precision paths.

liz-devex: We'll add snippet for fallback policy to docs.

leo: Will rates/pricing change? Need to update pricing page.

maya: Pricing for GA endpoints updated: small model runs priced 10% lower than minimax-2 to encourage migration. Finance + marketing coordinating external comms tomorrow.

hannah: Incident note: if you see 503s after rollout, escalate to eng-oncall and mention alert fastroute-503.

maya: Thanks everyone. Post any issues in #incidents + ping me. :rocket:

devops-bot: Deploy progress: 50% canary complete. No elevated error rates.

devops-bot: Deploy complete: 100% traffic. deploy-id=dr-1997. Rollout status: success.
